dict.string: Atlas connects to your Colmi R10 ring to read live heart-rate and motion for the liveness gate. Raw data is encrypted on this device and never leaves it.
Atlas captures depth-checked, provenanced photos and your enrolment face/depth anchor. Capture happens inside the attested app flow.
Atlas uses Face ID to gate the Secure Enclave authority and the in-person enrolment ritual.

Atlas fuses ambient sound level (loudness only, not recorded) into a live timing signal that schedules cryptographic draws. Audio is never stored and never enters a key. If you enable the spoken panic phrase, the microphone also listens on-device for that phrase to trigger a safety response.

If you enable the spoken panic phrase, Atlas recognizes that phrase ON DEVICE (never sent to Apple or any server) so you can trigger a safety response hands-free. Recognition is off unless you turn it on.
Atlas fuses accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer and barometer motion into a live timing/gating signal. Motion data times draws and gates the ratchet; it never enters a key.
Atlas connects to the Mac node on the local network for the two-phone run.
Atlas uses location as a presence/context signal and, under a duress unlock, streams it as sealed evidence off your device. It is never sold or shared.
Atlas can keep presence alive and, under a duress unlock, stream sealed evidence while the app is backgrounded. It is never sold or shared.
Atlas reads your passport/eID chip on this device to verify your Real-ID. The scan is local; document data never leaves your phone.
